validation.fig2fgh_hit_rates: 48/48 printed hit rates reproduced from a scale AND an origin taken from the y-axis ticks alone, max |delta| 0.40 pp, mean -0.04 pp, 25 of 48 deltas negative. Corrected twice. 2026-10-30 (F-006): until then the pixels-per-percent scale was least-squares fitted onto the Fig 2e rates this panel validates, so the agreement could not detect a scale error AND was absorbing a real one. 2026-11-07 (round-2 E2): the SCALE was re-anchored on the ticks but the ORIGIN was left as three hard-coded literals, and on 2f/2g the 0% tick is not drawn, so the literal baseline was 0.61 pp short on each -- that, not the colour mask, was the cause of the -0.52 pp one-sided residual the previous note recorded as inherent. Deriving the origin from the same tick fit removed it: mean -0.52 -> -0.04 pp and the negative-delta count fell from 47/48 to 25/48, which is what unbiased noise looks like
